text:
Lina Park: Hey team — just unboxed my onboarding kit. Monitor and dock are here but the monitor power brick is missing and the monitor stand screw kit is in a tiny bag with no hex key. Also when I try to join corp-wifi it keeps asking for a client cert that I don't have. Who do I ping?
IT Helpdesk: Welcome Lina! Sorry about that. Can you paste your order number from onboarding? We'll escalate to shipping. For wifi, what's the exact prompt (certificate name or error)?
Lina Park: order ONB-11088. wifi prompt says 'Select a certificate to use' but there's nothing listed. macOS Ventura 13.5.
Shipping (Marta): ONB-11088 confirmed. Looks like the accessory pack (power brick + hex kit) was omitted at pick. I can ship a 90W brick and a hex set today overnight. SHIP-1244.
Lina Park: thank you! do you need serial numbers?
Sam (Hardware): serial helps for warranty but not necessary for missing items. If you can DM the serial of the dock we can log it in case we need to swap.
Lina Park: DM'd dock SN: DCK-7F1B3.
Network Ops: For the cert prompt — that's the OS asking for a machine certificate (device cert). The enrollment sometimes doesn't finish during SSO. Try this: open Safari, go to https://enroll.redwood.com, sign in, and complete the device enrollment flow. If it fails with 403, reply here and we'll flip the device_enroll flag.
it-bot: Ticket created: IT-25001 (device cert), assigned to Network Ops.
Lina Park: tried enroll link and it failed with 403 after SSO.
Network Ops: flipped device_enroll for lina. Please retry in ~3 minutes and let us know the browser console response if it fails.
Lina Park: retried and install prompt showed up. Installed the profile and now corp-wifi appears and connects. thanks! :white_check_mark:
Shipping (Marta): SHIP-1244 updated with UPS 1ZBBB5556601234567. ETA tomorrow 9:30am. Includes 90W brick and hex kit. Marked high priority.
Lina Park: awesome. One more minor thing  monitor shows vertical banding when brightness > 70% on boot but goes away after a warm-up. should i open a ticket for that?
Sam (Hardware): if banding is only during cold boot and disappears, often suggests a panel firmware or cable seating issue. If the replacement brick + hex kit arrive and banding persists, we'll RMA the monitor. For now I'll note a follow-up on SHIP-1244.
Lina Park: sounds good, i'll test after the parts arrive and report back. thanks everyone! :wave:
